name: Short-Term Rental (Airbnb / VRBO)

yield.notes: Significantly higher gross revenue than long-term rental but much higher time and operational requirements.

flags: Local STR ordinances change frequently — some cities ban entirely
Airbnb can suspend or ban host accounts
High labor requirements without co-host or management company

prerequisites: Property with STR permit/license (check local regulations first)
startup_checklist: Verify local STR permit requirements and fees before any purchase
Research occupancy rates and ADR using AirDNA for your market
Set up professional listing: 20+ photos, detailed description, competitive pricing
Hire cleaning crew and automate guest communication with Hospitable or Guesty
Set up dynamic pricing with PriceLabs or Wheelhouse
failure_modes: City passes STR ban after significant investment
kill_criteria: Occupancy below 40% for 3 consecutive months at competitive rates
sources_note: Market data from AirDNA industry reports.
